rule.flat: neither end moves instructions retired or text by more than 0.1% of what the changed cases had
rule.wrong: an end saves on instructions or text and does not spend on the other
rule.worth tuning: any other row that moves something

instructions_note: instructions is [rucc as it is, rucc moved, gcc-16], summed over the counted cases
text_note: text is [as it is, moved] in bytes
compile_micros_note: wall time [as it is, moved] on a shared machine
